***Job opportunity in Hadera***

The company I work for is looking for a motivated and detail-oriented QA Engineer to join the team in a **full-time position.**

**Requirements**
* Experience with Client/Server architecture
* Web application QA experience
* E-Commerce website QA experience
* Strong manual testing capabilities
* Automation testing experience – advantage
* ERP system experience – significant advantage
* Self-managed, proactive, and highly motivated
* Good technical English 
* Fluent Hebrew - Big advantage
* Strong interpersonal skills and teamwork abilities

**Additional Information**
* Salary range: 10–12K
* Company located in Hadera 
* Accepting B1 partner/A5 visas 

Send your CV to: [shay@beres.co.il](mailto:shay@beres.co.il) (write that you were referred by Lior)
